name: 040-align-en-words
description: English forced alignment: audio + transcript -> per-word SRT. Asserts SRT structure (valid timestamps, monotonic segment numbers, expected segment count) but not exact word timings.

input_artifacts.notes: 3 short sine bursts at 440/523.25/659.25 Hz. Placeholder audio — the aligner accepts any decodable WAV; transcript-vs-audio agreement isn't asserted in placeholder mode.

ref_outputs.notes: Per-word ±100ms tolerance band is now active on `expected_words`. `expected_words` encodes the proportional-fallback baseline (whitespace-split prompt distributed across audio duration by character length). The `_audio_burst_onsets_ms` array preserves the original sine-burst onsets for the day a real Whisper backend is wired up; once that path is live, both bands must be ±100ms (i.e. real STT timings should also fit `expected_words` since the proportional centre-of-mass differs by <100ms only when words are short — here they aren't, and the burst onsets fall outside the fallback band). Until then, the conformance runner builds an `AlignedSegment` whose words come from `stt::proportional_word_timings(prompt, 0, audio_duration_ms)`, then asserts each emitted word's start time is within ±100ms of `expected_words[i].start_ms`.
